newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X shares tumble in early action.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X shares tumble in early action.

text.p: Shares in troubled Bre-X Minerals Ltd took another beating in early dealings on Wednesday as investors displayed more skepticism about its Busang gold property.
Bre-X shares tumbled to a 52-week low of 1.76 on the Toronto Stock Exchange before recovering slightly to trade down 0.44 at 1.85. Volume topped three million shares in the first half-hour of trade.
The stock was down 9/32 at 1-3/8 on Nasdaq.
One trader said the further tremors were partly due to a report in the Financial Post newspaper.

According to the report, which quoted an unidentified brokerage source, analysts who went on a junket last September to see the property in Indonesia were given souvenirs of core samples to take away with them.
One analyst reportedly sent his keepsake to be analyzed and was told there was no gold in the sample. The analyst assumed it was a mistake, the newspaper said.
"I guess (investors) don't think there's any gold after all," said another trader.

He said most of the interest that helped keep the stock afloat in the past few sessions came from retail and speculative investors. Most institutions had probably already liquidated their holdings, he added.
"I would say you would be hard-pressed to find any (institutions) that own it," the trader said.
Bre-X has been embroiled in controversy since tests by its partner Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc on the Busang gold property indicated the deposit may contain "insignificant" amounts of gold.
Bre-X has promised an independent audit of the site would confirm its estimate of 71 million ounces of gold, potentially the richest in the world.
While investors await further drill results from Freeport and Bre-X, the market has been awash with theories to explain the Busang controversy.
Much of the media interest on Tuesday and today was focused on geologist Michael de Guzman, who fell out of a helicopter in an apparent suicide two days before the Freeport revelation.
